assets.prompt: Create a production 2D game SPRITE SHEET, square transparent PNG, EXACT uniform 6 columns by 6 rows (36 equally sized cells), no visible grid, no lettering, no numbers. One consistent full-body chibi KNIGHT in every cell: chunky steel helmet with open face, friendly brown moustache, pale blue tabard, steel sword, small round gold-trim shield, brown boots. Same proportion, costume, scale and centered ground position every cell. Front three-quarter view facing DOWN AND RIGHT, suitable for top-down mobile lane battle. Style: clean hand-drawn flat cel illustration, firm dark charcoal outlines, simple pastel lavender/blue armor, cream skin, ochre gold details, restrained two-tone shading. Like a flat cartoon board-game icon, not 3D, not glossy, not pixel art. Each cell character fits inside the middle 80 percent with empty gutter on all sides, sword never crosses cells. Read rows left to right: Row 1 six sequential APPEAR / land-in-dust frames, translucent first then solid ready stance. Row 2 six subtle IDLE breathing frames. Row 3 six clearly different WALK cycle poses with alternating feet and shield sway, character stays centered. Row 4 six sequential SWORD ATTACK frames: windup, raised sword, fast slash, extension, recoil, ready. Row 5 six RALLY / weapon raising frames with tiny gold sparks, active distinct poses. Row 6 six DEFEAT frames: stagger, kneel, fall, small fading dust puff. NO background whatsoever, real transparent alpha. Entire sheet is a usable precisely spaced 6 by 6 animation atlas, uniform cells.
